_comment: Serena hook commands for the code-search pack, in the Claude Code hooks.json shape that @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code consumes. Mounted by the pack row code-search-hooks (configPath). SessionStart attaches the project-activation/read-manual context, PreToolUse runs the symbolic-tool reminder (denies after 3 consecutive grep calls, 3 code-file reads, or 4 mixed; 120 s cool-down; a Serena symbolic call resets it), Stop cleans that session state. WHY SERENA_HOME IS PINNED. Hook processes run through the harness shell, whose HOME is sandboxed per run, so Serena state under ~/.serena was invisible to the next hook process and the counter never accumulated (measured 2026-11-11: four real greps, all pass). Setting SERENA_HOME to ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.dsh/serena-hooks gives every hook process the same project-local state dir; the bridge substitutes CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR at config parse time. The directory is tool state under the already-gitignored .dsh/.
